Process lesson, third occurrence in one batch: a rate correction must be swept for EVERY value the same regulatory decision touched, not just the headline figure. The 1.7.2026 decision changed both the flat tariff and the TOU table; sweeping only for 0.6432 and '~64 agorot' left 52.83 and 168.95 live in three files. Equally, the arnona per-year fix was applied to SKILL.md and not SKILL_HE.md. Grep BOTH language files for every corrected concept, not just the changed literal.

TOP DEFERRED ITEM CLOSED, and it was the skill's own core premise: fixed charges were named but never priced, so a total bill could not be computed. The residential page carries the whole table and it is now in the skill: distribution and supply are TWO separate fixed charges, not one, and each varies by monthly-versus-bi-monthly billing and by single-versus-three-phase meter, plus a capacity charge per KVA per year. FABRICATION REMOVED: both language files listed an 'אגרת שידור ציבורי' (public broadcasting fee) among the charges an IEC customer keeps paying, in three places including the switching gotcha. The official tariff page enumerates exactly three fixed components, distribution, supply and capacity. Removed against a positive enumeration rather than an absence of evidence.

TOU COMPLETENESS: the table had the right prices but only stated the day rules for winter. In SUMMER and TRANSITION there is no peak band at all on Fridays, holiday eves, Shabbat or holidays, which is where a real household's weekend load sits. Added, with the page's own list of which holidays count as Shabbat and the note that hours follow Israel local time and are adjusted for summer time.

PROVIDER-OWNERSHIP CHECK, exactly the failure the batch brief predicted: the skill listed Golan Telecom as an independent MVNO alongside Hot Mobile. Golan's own About page says it formerly held its own licence, that since 24.12.2023 Golan Telecom services run on Cellcom Israel's licence, and that Golan International's activity moved to Cellcom Fixed-Line. A comparison skill telling a Cellcom customer to 'switch to Golan' is telling them to stay with the same licensee. Brand names outlive the companies behind them.

ARITHMETIC RETRACTED: the skill said the 1.7.2026 update 'cut the tariff by about 0.57%'. The move from 64.32 to 63.52 agorot is about 1.24%, so the stated percentage is not the change between the skill's own two figures and no source was carried for it. Replaced with the before-and-after values, which are verified.

EXPERT CRITICAL, and the single most valuable finding of the cycle: the electricity social tariff was narrowed from TWELVE statutory groups to three. I rendered iec.co.il/content/tariffs/contentpages/socialtariff with location.href asserted and it says '12 הקבוצות הן' and lists them. Large families with 4+ children, single parents with 3+, lone soldiers and soldiers on distance rent assistance, IDF disabled and hostile-action casualties, nursing levels 5-6, disabled-child allowance for dependence or special medical treatment, and special-services allowance at 112% and at 50% were ALL absent. A household in any of those groups reading this skill would have concluded it was not entitled. All twelve are now listed in both languages.

AND the mechanism by which that entitlement silently fails: the awarding body passes the details to IEC, but the discount only lands if the entitled person is the REGISTERED IEC consumer under their own name and ID. Anyone entitled who sees no reduced payment should call 103 and fix the registration. That step was missing and it is the difference between a right and money.

EXPERT CRITICAL: the entire solar export regime was misstated against the skill's only source for it. The pv-magazine article describes a PROPOSAL under consultation with tracks of 0.60 falling to 0.3807 (up to 30 kW) and 0.39 CPI-linked (up to 15 kW), and identifies 0.48 over a fixed 25 years as the then-INCUMBENT rate. The skill presented 48 agorot plus a '+6 agorot urban premium for cities over 50,000' as adopted, and instructed the agent NOT to quote the 0.60 and 0.38 figures, which are the source's own. The premium and the population threshold appear in no source. Worse, Example 1 built a payback and a 25-year lifetime saving on it. Step 3 now refuses to quote an export tariff at all and says why, and the example prices only self-consumption at the verified retail rate.

EXPERT CRITICAL: LPG was described as price-controlled by the Energy Ministry with a monthly published maximum. The ministry surface the skill itself links is a locality-and-supplier COMPARISON calculator sitting beside supplier-switching guides, which only exists because prices differ. The skill was pointing users away from the one lever that moves this bill. Corrected, and the absence of any LPG price anchor is now stated rather than left implicit.

PROVIDER SWEEP WAS INCOMPLETE, caught by the Expert: having learned the Golan/Cellcom lesson I applied it to exactly one row of a six-row table. we4g.co.il now serves we-com.co.il branded 'wecom', so We4G is no longer the operating brand either. MOVING CONTENT TO PASS A WORD CAP CARRIES THE DEFECT WITH IT. SKILL.md Example 2 was rewritten to stop drawing a relocation conclusion from the unsourced 8-city arnona table, but the moved copies in references/details-2026.md still drew exactly that conclusion in a confident shekel figure, in both languages, and the reference file is what the agent is told to consult. Same pattern for the protected-consumer absolutes SKILL.md now forbids. Every trim has to be followed by a read of the destination.

The reference file was also a generation behind the body on telecom (Rami Levy shown on Pelephone at 20-30 with unlimited calls, when the skill's own evidence records it as Hot Mobile with minute bundles at 14.90-55; IBC at '260 localities' which that evidence entry says was wrong; '~30 NIS for unlimited calls + 50GB' against the body's 33-35 for 150-400GB). All withdrawn.

WITHDRAWN as unsourced this cycle: the 360,000 / 280,000 private-supplier headcounts (the evidenced figure is ~279,500 who switched during 2025), the 520 MW February 2026 tender, fiber '>90% of households', and natural gas '40-60% cheaper per cooking hour'.

Arnona liability was never stated: it falls on the מחזיק, the OCCUPIER, so in a rented flat the TENANT pays. In a skill built around relocation and cost comparison that is the most consequential single fact and it was in neither language. The 90/60/30/45 objection ladder is now explicitly flagged as not independently verified, because a wrong deadline forfeits a legal right.

The water Tier-1 rule has two limbs and the English body carried only one. It is up to 3.5 m3 per registered person AND not less than 7 m3 per housing unit; the floor is what a one- or two-person household needs and it was buried in a gotcha. The Hebrew already had it, which is its own lesson about checking both directions for parity.

The priced fixed-charge table needed a row-selection rule to be usable: a normal apartment is a bi-monthly single-phase customer, and the monthly rows are about sixteen times larger per period. Publishing a correct table without saying which row applies is not the same as making a bill computable.

I COMMITTED THE EXACT DEFECT I HAD JUST LOGGED. Having written the lesson that moving content to pass a word cap carries the defect with it, I then fixed all three CRITICALs in the English body only. A third reviewer found the retracted solar regime still live in SKILL.md's own Gotchas, in ALL of SKILL_HE.md (Step 3, Example 1 and the Gotcha, untouched), and four times in the reference file including a worked example still multiplying the withdrawn 0.54 rate over 25 years into a 183,000 shekel lifetime saving that Step 3 expressly forbids. The LPG and twelve-group fixes were likewise absent from the reference file, which is the file the skill tells the agent to consult. Hebrew is the primary reading language here, so a body-only fix reaches the minority of users.

The operative rule, and it is now enforced by a scripted sweep rather than by care: after ANY retraction, grep every literal across SKILL.md, SKILL_HE.md and every reference file, and require zero live hits before the gate is called green. Withdrawing a figure in one of three copies is not withdrawing it.

Asymmetries the same sweep caught: the water 7 m3 floor, the arnona מחזיק (occupier pays, so the tenant in a rented flat) rule, and the fixed-charge row-selection rule each existed in one file and not the others; the Hebrew gotcha still anchored the tariff on the superseded January 2026 edition; and the withdrawn Beer Sheva relocation saving, the 40-60 percent gas figure and the 19-30 shekel unlimited plan each survived in a copy the withdrawal had not reached.
